criteria.question: Can the post's one idea be said in a sentence, and does every section serve it?
Does each load-bearing claim carry its proof, with wording no stronger than the proof?
Does the reader leave believing something they did not believe at the start?
Are the facts ones only this subject has, rather than ones any post on the topic would carry?
Does it read as the writer's own voice, free of machine-prose tells?

caps.when: a figure, source or case is invented or cannot be traced to the material
the post has no idea that a reader could disagree with
the main claim has no proof at all
